description: This Java test source file defines a suite of unit tests for the OpenMRS project, specifically testing the correctness and conventions of the existing JUnit test classes within the org.openmrs package. It includes checks for test method naming conventions, class naming standards, migration to JUnit 5, and ensuring proper annotations.

classes.name: OpenmrsTestsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the correctness, naming conventions, and migration status of test classes and methods within the org.openmrs package.

methods.name: shouldHaveAtLeastOneTest
methods.description: Checks that there is more than one test class present in the package.

methods.name: shouldStartWithShould
methods.description: Ensures all test methods in the test classes begin with 'should' or contain '_should'.

methods.name: shouldHaveTestAnnotationWhenStartingWithShould
methods.description: Verifies that methods starting with 'should' or containing '_should' have an @Test or equivalent annotation.

methods.name: shouldHaveClassNameEndWithTestIfContainsMethodTestAnnotations
methods.description: Checks that classes containing @Test methods are properly named with a 'Test' suffix unless annotated to ignore.

methods.name: shouldNotAllowAnyNewJUnit4TestsSinceWeMigratedToJUnit5
methods.description: Ensures that no new JUnit 4 tests have been added, enforcing migration to JUnit 5.

methods.name: getTestClasses
methods.description: Retrieves classes ending with 'Test', 'IT', or 'PT' within the test package.

methods.name: getClasses
methods.description: Loads classes matching a regex pattern from the org.openmrs package.

methods.name: getClassesInDirectory
methods.description: Recursively scans a directory to find and load classes matching a pattern.
